_comment: Cards that were Done on the roadmap board BEFORE roadmap.json started carrying
its own landed history, and have since been archived off the board.
They need a seed because ARCHIVED ITEMS ARE UNREACHABLE: the GitHub Projects v2
API returns only live items (ProjectV2.items has no includeArchived argument), so
an archived card cannot be re-read from the board at any later date. These two
were recovered from the git history of apps/landing/src/data/roadmap.json.
This file is read ONCE in effect: roadmap-export.mjs merges any id it has not
already recorded, and from the next export they live in roadmap.json itself. It
should never need another entry: a card Done from now on is captured while it is
still on the board. Never add a card here that was not actually shipped.
